name: dither-image
blurb: Image with a CSS-only Bayer dither effect that converts photos to stylized dot patterns.
description: Compound component wrapping images with a dither-plugin-powered CSS filter. Renders dithered images via DitherImageFrame with tunable grayscale, contrast, brightness, and blur. Includes DitherImageReveal for partial reveals.
use_when: Retro-styled galleries or when a halftone/dither aesthetic complements the visual design.
avoid_when: Photography where fidelity is paramount, or browsers without CSS filter support.
a11y: Images have alt text. Captions are semantic <figcaption>. Visual effect only.
